name: Soft Focus
title: A quieter, more deliberate baseline.
note: Open counters, a medium title weight, and a warm neutral accent. A 24px content inset gives the type and the photo the same left edge.
label: #aab3ba
spacing: 16px after the venue; 24px between major detail groups.

name: Humanist
title: Softer reading, cleaner information.
note: A humanist sans with clear numerals and a slightly larger optical size. The rhythm stays compact without tightening the line height.
label: #b3bab5
spacing: 26px titles optically match the smaller x-height; body text sits on a 20px line.

name: Warm Editorial
title: A small editorial inflection.
note: A restrained serif for event names, paired with a quiet sans for everything practical. The original composition and photo still do the work.
label: #b7afa1
spacing: Serif titles get 32px lines and 20px of breathing room before the next information group.

name: Open Form
title: Rounder forms, lighter touch.
note: A generous x-height and softer shapes make a modest weight feel confident. A cool charcoal surface keeps the apricot accent understated.
label: #aab7c3
spacing: An even 24px card rhythm, 8px local gaps, and slightly rounder action corners.

name: Studio Notes
title: Precise, with a little character.
note: Plex gives the listings a studio noticeboard quality. Monospaced category labels add structure while the main reading stays proportional.
label: #b0c0b6
spacing: 20px edges and a measured 4px rule system; a monospaced label does not take over the body copy.

name: Quiet Air
title: A little more room to settle in.
note: Fewer heavy weights, more negative space, and a narrower accent range. The larger inset makes the image-led detail feel especially composed.
label: #b0b9bd
spacing: 28px shared edges, 20px venue-to-metadata spacing, and 28px separation before the primary action.
